canonical_name: No Outcomes Prioritized Based on Dependencies
description: Outcomes, capabilities, and services that depend on others are not prioritized.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity risk management Enterprise governance and leadership functions Strategic planning and risk management teams Organizations subject to regulatory compliance requirements

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of dependency mapping documentation, missing third-party and vendor risk assessments, lack of documented critical dependencies on external services, no evidence of supply chain risk management, missing documentation of organizational reliance on external capabilities.
